QuestInfo.name: Kidnapping of Camila
QuestInfo.0: Chief Stan is calling you urgently... What could this be about?
QuestInfo.1: Chief Stan says that #p1012108#, who went out of town to pick strawberries, has been kidnapped by Golems. He asks that you go to Golem's Temple and rescue #p1012108#.
QuestInfo.2: Fortunately, you were able to rescue #p1012108#, but what was that strange Golem?

0.0: Oh no! #p1012108# has been kidnapped by the Golems! I warned her to stay home, but she went out to pick strawberries! One of the Golems grabbed #p1012108# and disappeared into the Golem's Temple!
0.1: We don't have much time! Please, hurry over to the #bGolem's Temple#k and rescue #b#p1012108##k!

yes.0: I don't know how far the Golem went! You must hurry! Please, bring back #p1012108#!

no.0: This is no time for jokes! Quit stalling and accept my request!

1.0: You've brought #p1012108# back! Phew, what a relief. I never thought something so scary would happen.

yes.0: I must come up with a plan. Just hold on a minute. I have to concentrate.

default.0: Why are you just standing there like that? Go into the #bGolem's Temple#k and rescue #b#p1012108##k! You can do it, can't you?! You must!
